evidence.note: Traced the single-pass str.format emulation: {{ and }} escapes each advance i by one extra byte, slot name slicing t[i+1:i+j] with i+=j lands on the closing brace, unterminated slot and lone '}' both return ERR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE, and slot values are written verbatim without rescanning (confirmed by testdata/prompts/match.calibration.golden, which renders literal {candidate} and }} from the untrusted values).

CutDiff backs off to a rune start before slicing and cannot index out of range because the cut only runs when len(diff) > MaxDiffBytes; truncated is sticky from the caller's already-truncated flag; sha1 names the post-cut bytes.

Parse fail-closed behaviour checked: match/adjudicate require the bool and return decision false on parse failure, still-present returns decision true on failure and persists still_present:null with a perr string; stripFences cannot panic on a bare or unterminated fence since SplitN always yields at least two parts when the prefix matches.

commitExists requires both a new commit since FixEntryHead and a clean tree, reports every git failure as CodeGit so the audit shows it, and emits status plus working diff in the ERR_NO_COMMIT detail; nothing_found/nothing_confirmed refuse once AllFound is non-empty, so a discovery miss cannot end a loop clean.

Lock ordering audited: get() never locks and is only called under mu; Create/Append/RepairTail/EventsWithLines/Lock hold mu for their whole body; List snapshots ids and releases mu before calling Events, so no re-entrant deadlock. Append and RepairTail both refuse without the lock held (CodeRunLocked), EventsWithLines copies lines before parsing, and the unlock closure re-acquires mu.

New test sizes its fixture from maxJSONLLineBytes (1<<20 in runchain.go:17) and asserts the exact length plus the >64 KiB bufio-default guard; strings is already imported at runchain_test.go:6, so the hunk compiles.
review-loop transitions cover both discover outcomes and both adjudicate outcomes; vars declare required JUDGE/JUDGE_EFFORT with defaults for the reviewer side and repo_mode advisory.

Sharded-review docs agree with CLAUDE.md: results are committed under docs/metareview/shards/ while .metareview/shards/ packs stay local; no TODO/FIXME markers, eval, or truncated diff context anywhere in this shard, and every source file changed here has an adjacent test (gate_test.go, judge_test.go, store_test.go, runchain_test.go).
